home.title: Charming 3-star hotel in central Saint-Quentin
home.description: Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre, a charming 3-star hotel in the heart of Saint-Quentin, near the Théâtre Jean-Vilar and the Basilica. Heated pool, L'Entracte bar, organic local breakfast.
home.heroTitle: Welcome to a cosy, refined world
home.heroText: In the historic centre, a short walk from the Théâtre Jean-Vilar and the Basilica.
home.heroAlt: The terrace of Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre in the inner courtyard, with outdoor lounges and lit façade
introText: Welcome to Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre. We are delighted to welcome you to our 3-star hotel, designed to offer you a quality stay.
A comfortable, stylish living room, breakfast on the terrace in fine weather, a bar for a coffee, a cocktail or a glass of wine, a pool and a wellness area: everything is here for a charming stay.
home.roomsText: From the Comfort Room to the Suite, every room is carefully decorated: premium bedding, soundproofing and bespoke furniture.
home.barText: Hot drinks, cocktails, selected wines and sharing boards, in a cosy setting blending Moroccan influences and Art Deco charm, or out on the terrace in fine weather.
home.poolText: A heated indoor pool with a counter-current swimming lane, unique in the Saint-Quentin area. Loungers by the water to recharge after a day of sightseeing or work.
home.poolMeta: Daily · 9 am – 9 pm · Hotel guests only
home.breakfastText: A generous buffet of organic, local, quality produce: pastries, assorted breads, fresh fruit, regional specialities and homemade treats. In the breakfast room, on the terrace, to take away or in your room.
home.seminarsText: Two bright, flexible rooms opening onto a garden, for meetings, training and residential seminars in the heart of Saint-Quentin.
home.cityText: Easy to reach from Paris, Lille or Amiens, Saint-Quentin will charm you with its architectural heritage, lively shopping streets and green spaces. Our team will gladly recommend the best local activities.
directPerks: Best rate guaranteed on our official website
Private secure car park and EV charging
Free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel

hotel.title: The hotel
hotel.description: Discover Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre, your 3-star address in the heart of Saint-Quentin: 32 rooms in 6 categories, amenities and services for a cosy, refined stay.
hotel.heroText: Your 3-star address in the heart of Saint-Quentin.
introText: Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre welcomes you to a refined, cosy setting, a stone's throw from the Théâtre Jean-Vilar.
Our wish: to offer our guests a unique experience and a warm welcome.
equipmentRequestList: Shoe-shine, manicure, sewing and first-aid kits
hotel.relaxText: Some rooms have a rooftop or a terrace, giving you a private place to unwind. The heated pool and L'Entracte bar complete the experience.
hotel.servicesText: 24-hour reception, concierge service, secure luggage storage, hotel shuttle on request and e-bike rental.
hotel.comfortText: Soundproofed rooms, premium bedding, French cotton linen and duck down in the Privilege Rooms, well-appointed bathrooms and toiletries.

rooms.title: Our rooms
rooms.description: 32 air-conditioned rooms in 6 categories, from the Comfort Room to the Suite, at Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre in Saint-Quentin. Rates from €89 per night.
rooms.heroText: 32 air-conditioned rooms with elegant comfort in a refined setting.
intro: All our rooms have high-speed Wi-Fi. Most overlook the hotel's private courtyard; the others face one of Saint-Quentin's typical streets.
Two rooms for guests with reduced mobility are also available.
infoList: Check-in from 3 pm, check-out by 11 am.
Late check-out or early check-in: €10 per hour.
A valid credit card in the name of the booking is required at check-in.
Official ID is required (ID card, passport or driving licence).
Accepted payment methods: debit card, Visa, Mastercard. Cheques are not accepted.
Pets welcome in some categories (€20 supplement).

apartments.title: Our apartments
apartments.description: A 55 m² apartment and a 35 m² studio with fitted kitchen and hotel service, at Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre in Saint-Quentin. Short and long stays.
apartments.heroText: The freedom of an apartment, the services of a hotel.
apartments.intro: For a family stay, a business trip or a long stay, our apartments with fitted kitchens include hotel service: bed linen, towels and cleaning.
apartments.availability: Available for short or long stays: please contact us.

bar.title: L'Entracte bar
bar.description: L'Entracte, the bar at Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre in Saint-Quentin: cocktails, wines, hot drinks and sharing boards, with a terrace. Open 6:30 am to 11 pm.
bar.heroText: An elegant interlude in the heart of your stay.
text: Settle in at L'Entracte, a friendly haven at the heart of the hotel. Whether you are passing through or staying with us, it is the perfect place to relax at any time of day.

A hot drink, a refined cocktail or a carefully selected glass of wine: let our menu guide you. Pair your drink with a tasty snack or share a board of charcuterie and cheese in a warm, intimate atmosphere.
A solo break, drinks with friends or a moment for two: L'Entracte invites you to an interlude of pleasure.
bar.hours: Open daily from 6:30 am to 11 pm
bar.terraceSubtitle: A peaceful bubble in the heart of Saint-Quentin
bar.terraceText: Sheltered from the bustle, our terrace welcomes you in a green, soothing setting where time seems to stand still. In the sun or in the shade, enjoy the gentle, elegant atmosphere.

services.title: Our services
services.description: Heated pool, bar, organic local breakfast, e-bike rental, day use and services at Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre in Saint-Quentin.
services.heroText: Everything for a relaxing stay, from breakfast to the pool.
poolText: A beautiful tropical-style indoor pool for young and old, with a counter-current swimming lane several metres long, unique in the Saint-Quentin area.
A few lengths on holiday or a swim after work: this pool is a true oasis, with loungers by the water.
poolList: Quiet area, out of respect for everyone
Bathrobe and slippers on request (extra charge)
services.barText: In a cosy setting blending Moroccan influences and Art Deco charm, the bar welcomes you every day from 6:30 am to 11 pm, inside or on the terrace. Coffee, tea, a cold drink or a local aperitif, with sharing boards and homemade sweets.
breakfastText: Served from 6:30 to 10:30 am in our bright breakfast room, breakfast features organic, local, quality produce.

The buffet offers hot drinks, assorted breads, pastries, fresh fruit, sweet, savoury and dairy products, plant-based alternatives, regional specialities and homemade treats. Enjoy the terrace in fine weather. In a hurry? Take it away. Want privacy? Choose room service (extra charge).
services.bikeText: Explore Saint-Quentin freely. Book in advance at reception; ID and a deposit are required when you collect the bike.
services.bikePrices: €{half} half day · €{day} full day · helmet included
services.dayUseText: Need a break between meetings, a quiet place to work or simply some time for yourself? Our rooms are available during the day at a preferential rate.
dayUseList: High-speed Wi-Fi, desk and room service
Lunch or snack served in your room

Newspapers and board games for all ages
paidList: Snacks via room service, in the breakfast room or on the terrace

discover.title: Events & discoveries
discover.description: Things to do in Saint-Quentin: the Basilica, Théâtre Jean-Vilar, Parc d'Isle, Familistère de Guise… Tips from Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre for exploring the Aisne.
discover.heroText: Saint-Quentin and the Aisne, behind the scenes.
intro: Located in the heart of Saint-Quentin, in the Aisne, the hotel is the gateway to a wide range of sights and festive events.

Looking for a restaurant, a visit or an outing? We keep a list of activities and places to discover around Saint-Quentin, in the Aisne and across Hauts-de-France. Tell us about your plans for advice, activity bookings or possible preferential rates with our local partners.
discover.eventsText: Follow our news and upcoming events on Instagram and Facebook.

seminars.title: Meetings & seminars
seminars.description: Flexible meeting rooms for up to 40 people in the heart of Saint-Quentin: interactive screen, breaks, catering and on-site accommodation at Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre.
seminars.heroText: A dedicated space for your business events, in the heart of Saint-Quentin.
intro: At Les Coulisses du Théâtre, we offer a space designed to combine comfort, functionality and elegance.

Our meeting space consists of two flexible rooms that can be used separately or together: small meetings, conferences or larger training sessions. Bathed in light, it is a setting that encourages work, discussion and focus.
To round off your event, the hotel offers catering, relaxing moments at the bar and on-site accommodation.
includedList: Break: tea, coffee, fruit juice, pastries and fruit (one per half day)
Step-free access, on the ground floor with French window onto the garden
seminars.extraText: Lunch: buffet, hot meal or meal tray on reservation.

contact.description: Contact Hôtel Les Coulisses du Théâtre, 8 rue de la Comédie, Saint-Quentin: phone, email, form, map, train station, buses and nearby car parks.
contact.heroText: Information, a quote or a booking? Write to us and we will reply as soon as possible.
contact.arrival: The hotel entrance is on the right-hand side of the street. Drive in under the archway to park by reception, then access the secure car park.
